labs.name: Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research Lab
labs.description: Official CHAI/BAIR-related Berkeley materials and widespread official faculty affiliations identify BAIR as UC Berkeley's Artificial Intelligence Research Lab. Official EECS faculty with AI research interests are commonly affiliated with BAIR; this record is included because BAIR is the official campus AI research organization used on Berkeley AI faculty pages. Individual professor-lab links are set only where an official page states the affiliation.
labs.research_summary: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, robotics, and natural language processing research at UC Berkeley.
